product_from_film: Gemini Deep Think is presented as a research assistant for choosing semiconductor growth conditions and automating lab workflows.
explains_well: Lab work, a molecular model, furnace handling and parameter charts connect the AI claim to a physical research task.
unclear: The recommended thermal profile is not traced through one experiment to its measured result.

product_clear_basis: The opening ASR states that the lab uses Deep Think to design new semiconductors; the visual lab context supports the domain.
